snippet.title: Shmup! - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Shmup! is a fast-paced arcade shoot ’em up inspired by classic STG and bullet hell action. Dodge dense enemy fire, destroy waves of enemies, and chase high scores through explosive arcade gameplay.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4282220/Shmup/

Features:

Intense bullet hell gameplay
Fast arcade-style action
5 powerful special weapons to chose from
Screen clearing bombs
Retro-inspired STG gameplay
Score chasing and survival

If you enjoy shoot ’em ups inspired by games like Crimzon Clover, Blue Revolver, DoDonPachi, and classic arcade STGs, add Shmup! to your wishlist.
